'''Zenhai''' was a [[Republic soldier|soldier]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Zenhai was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and served with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] in the [[battle of Kalandis Seven]]. During the course of the [[Ground warfare/Legends|engagement]], Zenhai and the rest of the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were given orders to destroy the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]] and were ultimately successful in their mission.

==Biography==
[[File:Shanra_Immel_headshot.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Zenhai's sergeant, Shanra Immel]]
Zenhai served as a [[Republic soldier|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} As "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" takes place after the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], and Malcom states it has been 40 years since the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]], the story must thus take place in 3640 BBY.</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], Zenhai was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]]&mdash;along with [[Camur]], [[Eron (soldier)|Eron]], [[Vaskus Kayle]], [[Amden vor Keioidian]], [[Min-Reva]], and [[Yennir of the Green]]&mdash;and [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|fought]] alongside [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] on the desolate [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]]. During the [[Ground warfare/Legends|battle]], Zenhai and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were tasked with the destruction of a local Imperial-controlled [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]]. On the way to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Zenhai and the squad were attacked, and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] Keioidian was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded. Immel activated Keioidian's [[med tracer]] before ordering the squad to move out and leave Keioidian behind.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, Zenhai and the squad finally reached the spaceport and were ordered to check in with Immel before proceeding with the mission, while Malcom attempted to capture a [[Unidentified planetary command ship|Sith planetary command ship]]. Zenhai and the squad started planting [[targeting beacon]]s, which would allow their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the spaceport regardless of the planet's [[Water/Legends|fog]]. Shortly after they finished planting the last of the beacons, the spaceport was eliminated, though Malcom failed to capture the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zenhai first appeared in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story, ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'', which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]]<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> and released on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
